mapper.insert: insert into project (name, priority, type ,status,pm,pm_id,plan_start_date,plan_end_date, `desc`, create_man_id, create_man) values (#{name}, #{priority}, #{type},#{status}, #{pmName},#{pmId},#{planStartDate},#{planEndDate}, #{desc}, #{createManId}, #{createMan})
mapper.select: select id,name, priority, type ,status,pm_id,plan_start_date,plan_end_date, actual_start_date,actual_end_date,`desc`, create_man_id, create_man,create_date,modify_date from project where id = #{id} and is_deleted=false

select a.id,a.name, a.priority, a.type ,a.status,a.pm pmName,a.plan_start_date,a.plan_end_date, a.actual_start_date,a.actual_end_date,a.create_man,c.name productLineName,d.name bizDomainName, e.user_name pdName,f.user_name teamMember
order by a.create_date desc limit #{offset},#{size}
